== Summary ==
PC Errata 2016 disc card image of [[Beru Lars (PC Errata 2016 disc card)]]: PC Errata 2016 disc card (Players Committee card image with a bronze disc mark, starwarsccg.org card lists).

Source: Players Committee card image [http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Premiere-Light/large/berulars.gif berulars.gif] in the starwarsccg.org card lists.
